qualification.source: v03 development object 11, chosen before new solves
qualification.model: same log-J Neo-Hookean and Robin surface stiffness; consistent surface integration
qualification.sampling: 425 structured displacement points; 512 scrambled Sobol interior strain points; 64 support-interior traction points
qualification.policy: Require all four actions to pass successive P2 spatial refinements and quadrature checks; do not rebuild inference on failed reference
qualification.scope: Single difficult development fixture, no inference/test-set retuning; finite convergence evidence, not analytic error bound

protocol.model: Consistent surface Robin integration, graded P2 tetrahedra, log-J Neo-Hookean; all four loads unchanged from v03
protocol.split_policy: Development reused for diagnosis; calibration and test parameter draws newly seeded. Test outcomes do not select models, calibration scales or policies.
protocol.prior: Uniform fixture category; independent log-uniform E[1500,10000] Pa and K[400,16000] N/m
protocol.bank_interpolation: Cubic tensor interpolation in log E,K; development direct-solve check <=30 micrometres RMS
protocol.discrepancy: Development-only fine-minus-bank mean and joint covariance, 10% diagonal shrinkage and 1 micrometre SD floor
protocol.calibration_rule: Object-wise max over all three observation budgets, 243 target coordinates and four repeats; 19th/20 score for 90% simultaneous bands
protocol.inference_success: Posterior predictive moments and marginal physical quantiles converge; report raw E/K coverage separately from calibrated displacement bands
protocol.probing_success: Positive object-bootstrap 95% improvement versus fixed AND fixture-side heuristic, coverage >=90%, stable numerical decisions
protocol.scope: Known geometry and force, unknown E/K and fixture category; static synthetic numerical reference, not real video, gravity/contact or learned PhysTwin
